data.narrative:
Orchid is a Series A biotech company founded by Noor Siddiqui that has raised $16.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage companies including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome.

Of the three valuation methods tested, only stage-progression analysis proved applicable. This method uses the $16.5M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A to subsequent-stage progression, yielding an implied valuation of $33M. Peer-median analysis could not be applied due to insufficient narrow peer coverage within the biotech sector—while 7 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 met filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation-tier comparability. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (8.1x median across the 3 public comps) was inapplicable because Orchid's revenue is not disclosed.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $28M to $38M, centered on $33M. This estimate carries meaningful uncertainty given reliance on a single method and the absence of revenue or financial operating metrics typical for early biotech validation. Any refinement would require disclosure of Orchid's clinical or pipeline stage, comparable transaction pricing among private peers, or preliminary financial traction.
